/sku ni rnam snang nyid gsungs pa/ /ji ltar mi bskyod phyag rgya lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems spangs nas ni lus kyis ni/ /mdzes pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir rnam par snang mdzad sems/ /sku la thugs kyi phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ chu khams ri khrod mar bshad pa/ /mi bskyod khu ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /gtso bo mi bskyod phyag rgyas ni/ /ri khrod ma la phyag rgyar rigs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lus spangs nas ni sems kyis ni/ /gnas pa gzhan du mthong mi 'gyur/ /de phyir sems ni gti mug 'gyur/ /thugs la gti mug phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ me ni gdol pa mor bshad pa/ /'dod chags phyag rgyas gdol pa mo/ /rigs te phyag rgya gzhan min na/ /ji ltar rin chen phyag rgya lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang phyir 'dod chags khrag bshad pa/ /khrag ni rin chen 'byung gnas nyid/ /drod ni khrag gi rang bzhin phyir/ /'dod chags ser sna'i phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ gang phyir g.yung mo rlung nyid de/ /don yod rlung gi gzugs can nyid/ /don yod phyag rgyas g.yung mo la/ /gtso bo phyag rgyar rigs par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dod chags ma gtogs phrag dog ni/ /gzhan du 'byung ba ma yin te/ /de phyir 'dod chags phyag rgya yis/ /mkhas pas g.yung mo phyag rgyas gdab/ /gang phyir gzugs ni sra ba nyid/ /dkar mo snang mdzad gsungs pa nyid/ /sngar gsungs nyid kyi rim pa yis/ /sems kyi bdag pos phyag rgyas gdab/ /de nyid rim pas chom rkun ma/ /de bzhin ro langs ma nyid dang / /de yi rigs pas ghasma rī/ /ma log pa las phyag rgya'o/ /kye yi rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /snyoms 'jug gnas pa'i lha nyid la/ /sems can don phyir gtor ma che/ /de la bdag med mas zhus pa/ /e waṃ rnam par bzhugs nas ni/

/bgegs dang log par 'dren pa las/ /sems can rnams kyi srog bsrung phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpas gtor ma bstan/ /oṃ ind+ra dza ma dza la dzakkha/ bhu ta bahni bā u rakkha tsanda sudzdza mā da pappa ta la pā tā le antha sappa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhūñdza dzi gha phulla dhū pa māṃ sa piṃ gha ampa sappa kadzdza sā dha khanti khu ṇi phe ḍa gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādya nutpanna twād/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gal te 'dis gtor mas 'byung po thams cad mchod par byed na/ rnal 'byor pa rnams legs par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams la bde ba dri ma med pa dang / lha mo rnams dang / 'gro ba rab tu 'byor ba rnams dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'dis 'byung po'i tshogs kyi phyir rtag tu gtor ma byin na/ dbang dang / mngon spyod dang / dgra'i sde 'jigs pa dang / bskrad pa dang / gsad pa dang / dgug pa dang / zhi ba dang / rgyas par yang 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ phyag rgya gang gis mkha' spyod ma/ /gang gis phyag rgyas sa spyod ma/ /gtso bo bdag gis sngar ma 'tshal/ /bcom ldan ji ltar phyag rgya bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang gsum 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /sku gsung thugs su phye ba las/ /steng dang 'og dang dbus gnas kyi/ /'khor lo'i dbus su rnam par gnas/ /sa spyod sku yi phyag rgya can/ /steng zhal sku yi rdo rje ma/ /mkha' spyod 'dod chags phyag rgya can/ /'og zhal gsung gi rdo rje ma/ /thugs kyi rdo rjes bdag med ma/ /sems ni bdag med tshul can nyid/ /sems ni dbus kyi gnas su ste/ /des na bdag med ma dbus skye/ /rgyas par rab tu phye ba las/ /rigs ni rnam pa drug tu brjod/ /rnam gsum rnam pa lnga nyid kyang / /bshad kyis rnal 'byor ma nyid nyon/ /mi bskyod rnam snang rin chen 'byung / /dpag med phrag dog rdo rje sems/ /zhe sdang gti mug ser sna dang /

/'dod chags phrag dog bde ba dag /'dis ni rim pas bsgom pa nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' spangs na ni/ /phyi nas rigs ni rnam pa lnga/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /de rjes rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /mi bskyod zhe sdang gzugs can gyi/ /thugs kyi bdag po rigs gcig nyid/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i byin rlabs 'di/ /rigs ni drug dang lnga ru brjod/ /kyai rdo rje las rgyud thams cad kyi phyag rgya bsdus pa'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad pa/ /zhabs bzhi pa la 'jigs pa po/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /bdag med mas ni sku la 'khyud/ /phyag rgya lnga ni 'dzin lha la/ /bdag med ma ni nyid kyis zhus/ /bco lngas yongs su bskor ba yi/ /bdag gi 'khor lo khyod bshad na/ /khyod kyi dkyil 'khor ji ltar lags/ /gtso bo bdag gis sngar ma 'tshal/ /bdag med tsumba na mdzad nas/ /rdo rje thod par stsal nas ni/ /lha yis sta nam mnye mdzad de/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag rab tu bye/ /'khor lo ji ltar sngar gsungs pa/ /do shal do shal phyed pas brgyan/ /mtshams bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rdo rje srad bus yang dag brgyan/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin las/ /khyod dang lhan cig bzhin bzang ma/ /de la dbus su nga yod de/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /phyag ni bcu drug dag gis brgyan/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa nyid/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs pa po/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba'i do shal mdzad/ /nyi mar bzhugs shing rol mor bcas/ /kha dog nag po 'jigs pa po'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /nyid kyi zhal nas hūm̐ spro zhing / /thal bas lus la byugs pa nyid/ /bdag med lhan cig mnyam sbyor zhing / /dga' ba gnyis gnyis snyoms 'jug pas/ /rba rlabs med pa'i bde ba thob/ /rloms sems med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni nag po che/

/g.yas pa la ni kunda mtshungs/ /g.yon pa dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ /spyi bo'i zhal ni gtsigs pa can/ /spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhis che/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba bzhin/ /grong khyer nyams dgar khyod dang nga / /dga' bas shin tu rol pa las/ /dkar mo dbang po'i phyogs phyung nas/ /shar gyi sgo ru yang dag gnas/ /bsrub dang srub pa'i sbyor ba las/ /chom rkun ma yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas lho yi sgo ru ni/ /chom rkun ma ni sgo srung ma/ /bo la kakko la sbyor bas/ /ro langs ma yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas nub kyi sgo ru ni/ /bdud 'joms ma ni rnam par gnas/ /dga' ba chen po'i snyoms 'jug las/ /ghasma rī yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas byang gi sgo la ni/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can ma nyid gnas/ /gnyis kyis bskyod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /pukka sī yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas dbang ldan mtshams su yang / /drag po'i gzugs can ma nyid gnas/ /yang ni srub pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'tshengs pa'i mtshams su ri khrod ma/ /srin po'i mtshams su gdol pa mo/ /rlung gi mtshams su g.yung mo nyid/ /de nas rdo rje chags chen las/ /rig mar bcas pa khu bar gyur/ /sna tshogs glu yi mchod pa las/ /de nas lha mo rnams kyis bskul/ /rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /pukka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spangs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ /khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas/ /kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spangs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ /khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ /bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/

/mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad po la/ /gnyis 'thung la sogs rim shes bya/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang ni/ /me dang zla ba nyi ma nyid/ /mthar byed dang ni nor sbyin nyid/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na'o/ /sgeg cing dpa' bo mi sdug pa/ /dgod cing drag shul 'jigs rung ba/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yis/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /oṃ dang hūm̐ gis rdo rje che/ /khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhabs rnams sa la rdeb pa dang / /lha dang lha min bsdigs par mdzad/ /gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ 'di yi sa bon phyung ba dang / /bdag po'i sa bon dag gis ni/ /oṃ hūm̐ sngon po 'bar 'jigs pas/ /ma mo'i 'khor lo grong nyams dgar/ /kha dog nag po 'jigs chen po/ /bdag med bde ba sbyin pa po/ /gtso bo 'di ltar bsgom pa nyid/ /dkar mo g.yas na gri gug ste/ /de bzhin g.yon na ro hi ta/ /chom rkun ma g.yas cang te'u ste/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na phag pa nyid/ /ro langs ma g.yas rus sbal te/ /g.yon pa yis ni padma'i snod/ /ghasma rī yi g.yas na sbrul/ /g.yon pas rnal 'byor lhung bzed nyid/ /pukka sī g.yas seng ge ste/ /g.yon pas dgra sta de bzhin no/ /ri khrod ma g.yas dge slong ste/ /g.yon na gsil byed de bzhin no/ /gdol pa mo g.yas 'khor lo ste/ /g.yon pas thod pa de bzhin no/ /g.yung mo'i g.yas na rdo rje nyid/ /g.yon na sdig mdzub de bzhin no/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /dkar mo la sogs phyag gnyis brjod/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du ste/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gau rī kha dog nag mor 'gyur/ /chom rkun ma ni btsod dang mtshungs/ /ro langs ma ni gser btsos bzhin/ /ghasma rī ni margad mtshungs/ /pukka sī ni dbang sngon mtshungs/ /ri khrod ma ni zla nor 'od/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /g.yung mo sna tshogs pa zhes brjod/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag

/gshin rje dang ni nor bdag dang / /bden bral dang ni thags zangs ris/ /gau rī la sogs pa yi gdan/ /bo la gzhib par mdzad nas ni/ /dam 'khyud tsumba na mdzad nas/ /bcom ldan gus pas mchod nas ni/ /bdag med ma yis sngags zhus so/ /bud med rnams kyi dbang byed sngags/ /de bzhin gdug pa sdigs pa dang / /klu rnams sdigs par byed pa nyid/ /lha dang lha min rnam nyed pa/ /de ni nga yis bshad bya yis/ /lha mo bde ba sbyin ma nyon/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la/ /bdag gis gzhan du ma bstan to/ /'di yi sngags kyis gang byung dang / /rdo rje sems dpas gang mdzad pa/ /lha mo shin tu 'jigs pa ste/ /ngo mi chog pas khyod la bshad/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bzhengs nas ni/ /rdo rje snying po dbang sbyin phyir/ /thig le mchog ni bkug pa nyid/ /bzlas pa khri yis gsal ba dang / /sgra ring ba dang bzang ba yis/ /kye yi rdo rje sbyor ldan pas/ /btsun mo thams cad dgug par bya/ /bzlas pa 'bum gyis rnal 'byor bdag /kye yi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'di yis las rnams thams cad byed/ /rig byed rnams kyi dang po sbyin/ /zla phyed thig les rnam par brgyan/ /de nas aṣṭā na nā ya/ piṃ ga lordha ke sha wartam ne/ tsa tur biṃ sha ti ne trā ya/ de'i rjes la ṣāo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kriṣṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ne kandhā ri ṇe/ ādhmā ta krū ra tsittā ya/ ardhendu daṃ ṣṭi ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ /tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sapta sā ga rān/ bandha bandha/ nā ga aṣṭa kān/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ sha trūn/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ de nas lha mo de dges nas/ /bsrub dang srub pa'i sbyor ba las/ /dam 'khyud tsumba na byed pas/ /dkyil 'khor yid du 'ong ba zhus/

/de la ston pa ye shes che/ /rdo rje padma mnyam sbyar nas/ /dgyes pa'i thugs kyis mnyam gzhag pas/ /nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bri bar mdzad/ /'phar ma gcig dang sgo bzhi pa/ /sna tshogs 'od kyis yang dag 'khrugs/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje srad bus rnam par brgyan/ /re khā lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /de nas bum pa brgyad po bri/ /rin chen lnga yi phye ma'am/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pa yis/ /dur khrod kyi ni so phag gam/ /de bzhin dur khrod sol ba yis/ /de dbus padma 'dab ma ni/ /brgyad pa ze bar bcas pa bri/ /snying por skyes pa'i thod pa nyid/ /mdog dkar cha gsum pa ni bri/ /dbang ldan du ni sha ra bha/ /me yi mtshams su dge slong bri/ /bden bral du ni 'khor lo bri/ /rlung du rigs kyi bdag po bri/ /shar sgor de bzhin gri gug nyid/ /lho ru cang te'u bri ba nyid/ /nub tu rus sbal bri ba nyid/ /lto 'phye byang du de bzhin no/ /lha mo kha dog dbye ba yis/ /phyag mtshan brgyad du rab tu grags/ /dbus su thod pa dkar po yang / /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ /de nas rnam rgyal bum pa nyid/ /yal ga'i rtse mo gos bzang can/ /lto ba rin chen lngas gang ba/ /sā lu skyes pas yongs gang gzhag /mang du rab tu brjod pas ci/ /ji ltar de nyid bsdus pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga de bzhin bya/ /bcu gnyis brgyad gnyis lon pa yi/ /rig ma bde chen brgyad po nyid/ /do shal rkang gdub kyis brgyan nas/ /dkyil 'khor du ni rab tu gzhug /ma dang sring mo nyid dang yang / /bu mo sring mo'i bu mo dang / /de bzhin zhang po'i chung ma nyid/ /ma yi spun dang sgyug mo dang / /de bzhin pha yi sring mo nyid/ /rig ma brgyad du rab tu grags/ /dam 'khyud tsumba na byed pas/ /'di rnams rnal 'byor pa yis mchod/ /de las ga bur btung ba nyid/ /des ni dkyil 'khor bsang gtor bya/ /de rnams rnal 'byor pas btung bya/

/dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /de la chang yang btung ba dang / /sha dang sā lu skyes pa bza'/ /de yang gos dang phral byas nas/ /bha gar tsumpa yang yang byed/ /des kyang bo la gzhib par bya/ /gar bya glu yang blang bar bya/ /bo la kakko la sbyar nas/ /de la rtsed mo rtse bar bya/ /de nas thun tshod gnyis pa la/ /gos kyis mig ni bkab nas su/ /der ni slob ma gzhug pa nyid/ /phyi nas dkyil 'khor rab tu bstan/ /mtshan mo skye bo med khyim du/ /slob dpon la sogs rab phye nas/ /dbang ni ji ltar gsungs pa nyid/ /de la dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /ji ltar mchod dang bstod bshad pa/ /slob ma bzang pos sngar shes bya/ /de nyid de la bstan pa ni/ /dga' bral dang po mchog mtha' can/ /thams cad rgyud du sbas pa ste/ /mtha' yi mtha' ru phye ba nyid/ /rdo rje mchod pa rab sbyar nas/ /de la lha mo des zhus pa/ /lha de'i skad cig ji ltar lags/ /gtso bo chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /der ni thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa nyid/ /longs spyod kyi ni rlabs gnyis la/ /rang gi g.yas dang lag gzhan gyi/ /mthe bong dang ni srin lag gis/ /de ni rnal 'byor pa yis btsir/ /de nas ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /de la ci zhig skye zhe na/ /gzhon nu'i dga' ba ji lta ba'am/ /lkugs pa'i rmi lam ji lta ba'o/ /mchog gi mtha' dang dga' bral dbus/ /stong dang stong min he ru ka /kyai rdo rje las kye rdo rje mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //lha mo la ni dam 'khyud cing / /bo la thod par bcug nas ni/ /dam du ku tsa bzung mdzad nas/ /skyes pa'i mtha' ni gzhibs nas kyang / /tshems kyis ma mchu btsir nas ni/ /mchan khung sen mos rma mdzad de/ /mnyam sbyar bde ba myong mdzad nas/ /phyag rgya lnga ni rnam phye ba/

/bla ma slob dpon 'dod lha la/ /phyag 'tshal don du 'khor lo 'dzin/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /smod tshig mi nyan pa yi phyir/ /rna ba dag tu rna cha 'dzin/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa'ang mgul rgyan nyid/ /gdu bu srog chags gsod pa spangs/ /phyag rgya bstan pa ska rags nyid/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi phyag rgyas ni/ /rtag tu lus la phyag rgyas gdab/ /de nas rab tu bzhad mdzad nas/ /tshems kyis ma mchu btsir nas ni/ /kye yi rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs can nyid/ /de la lha mo des zhus pa/ /gtso bo cho ga gang gis dang / /de bzhin bya ba gang gis ni/ /kyai yi rdo rje'i bris sku yi/ /byed pa bde ba chen pos gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'dir ni 'dri mkhan dam tshig can/ /sgrub po'ang dam tshig can gyis ni/ /bris sku 'jigs pa bri ba nyid/ /skyes pa'i thod gnas kha dog lngas/ /ro yi skra yi pir nyid kyis/ /bris sku bla ma bri ba nyid/ /gang gang skud pa 'khal ba dang / /gang gang ras yug 'thag pa yang / /de yang dam tshig can nges pas/ /dam tshig byin rlabs rnal 'byor pas/ /zla ba zla ba'i mar ngo yi/ /bcu bzhi pa la khyim dben par/ /phyed na ma rungs sems kyis ni/ /chang gi btung ba cung zad las/ /lus la ni raṃ su bsams nas/ /de bzhin gcer bur gyur pas yang / /'bags pa dang ni ma dag pas/ /de nas dam tshig rab tu bza'/ /bzhin bzang snying rjer ldan pa dang / /gzugs dang lang tsho skal bzang ma/ /me tog bcas shing sgrub por dga'/ /rang gi phyag rgya g.yon du gzhag /kyai rdo rje las bris sku'i cho ga'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas de la lha mos zhus/ /bo la kakko la sbyar nas/ /tshems kyis ma mchu btsir nas ni/ /glegs bam yang ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /rdo rje padma mnyam sbyar nas/ /dgyes pas lha yi rab phye ba/ /glegs bam nga yis bshad bya yis/ /lha mo skal ba chen mo nyon/ /sbrang chen snag tsha byas nas ni/

/mi yi rus pa'i smyu gus ni/ /glegs bam sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /gro gar dam tshig can gyis bri/ /glegs bam dang ni bris sku nyid/ /gal te skal med mthong na ni/ /skye ba 'dir ni dngos grub med/ /'jig rten pha rol spyod yul min/ /yang dag rab sbyin ldan pa la/ /reg 'ga' tsam zhig bstan pa nyid/ /glegs bam lam gyi spyod yul du/ /skra dang mchan khung nyid du sba/ /bha gar liṅga rab sbyar nas/ /yang yang tsumba na mdzad nas/ /bde chen mnyam pa myong mdzad de/ /rdo rje can gyis bza' ba bstan/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bza' ba ni/ /nyon cig lha mo mig yangs ma/ /gang du zos pas 'dod don kun/ /sgrub pa can gyi mngon grub 'gyur/ /dur khrod ri yi bya skyibs dang / /de bzhin mi med grong khyer dang / /yang na dben pa'am rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /bza' ba 'di ni rab tu bza'/ /de la gdan du brtag pa ni/ /ro yi gzugs can dgu dang ni/ /yang na stag gi pags pa dang / /dur khrod ras ni de bzhin no/ /dbus su kye yi rdo rje'i gzugs/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin gnas shes nas/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral dag tu yang / /de nas rnal 'byor ma rnams dgod/ /dam tshig mā la tindha naṃ/ /stag gi pags pa'i steng du bza'/ /'bad pas rgyal po sā lu yi/ /bza' ba de nyid bza' ba nyid/ /der ni zos nas zos nas yang / /der ni ma mo mchod par bya/ /sring mo'i bu mo sgyug mo dang / /gal te ma sring yin na yang / /de rnams rtag tu legs mchod na/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'grub par 'gyur/ /skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig par/ /chang ni bzang pos yongs bkang ste/ /bla ma la dbul skal chen ma/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni rang yang btungs/ /padma'i lag pas blang ba dang / /de nyid kyi ni lag pas dbul/ /yang nas yang du rab btud pa/ /der ni sgrub pa po yis bya/ /kyai rdo rje las bza' ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor mas zhus pa/

/phyag rgya chen po ji lta bu/ /kun rdzob rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bde ba sbyin pas bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /shin tu ring min thung ba min/ /gnag pa ma yin dkar ba min/ /padma'i 'dab ma'i rnam pa 'dra/ /de yi dbugs ni dri zhim ldan/ /rdul kyang dri zhim ldan gyur te/ /ri dwags lte ba'i dri dang mtshungs/ /padma la yang dbang mchog dri/ /skad cig padma lta bu 'byung / /de yi ga bur sihla dag /mkhas pas dri bzang mtshon par bya/ /utpa la yi drir 'gyur zhing / /a ga ru ni nag po mtshungs/ /dal zhing mi g.yo ma nyid dang / /snyan par smra zhing yid 'ong ma/ /skra bzang dbus su gnyer ma gsum/ /phal pas padma can du brjod/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs can ma/ /de rnyed na ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma bdag med mas gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das smon lam ji ltar gdab par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rje can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /de nas lha mo de mnyes nas/ /tshig ni 'di nyid yang zhus pa/ /skal med sems can gdul dka' ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ /de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes na/ /de rjes kye yi rdo rje bstan/ /slob mas gus pas blangs na ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /kyai rdo rje las 'dus pa'i le'u zhes bya ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas kha sbyar 'byed pa yi/

/mtshan nyid yang dag rab tu bshad/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sgrub pos dngos grub thob 'gyur ba/ /bsgrub bya'i lte ba'i rtsa ba la/ /brtul zhugs can gyis lag pas gdon/ /he ru ka mnyam rnal 'byor gyis/ /nang gi ma rungs sems kyis ni/ /'di ni bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni nges par 'jig /bstan la gnod pa byed pa dang / /bla ma sangs rgyas 'jig pa ni/ /bla ma thub pa la zhus nas/ /snying rjes gsad par bya ba nyid/ /ji ltar phyugs kyi gzugs mthong nas/ /khrag ni skyug pa nyid dang yang / /'dar zhing mgo skyes grol ba dang / /kha ni 'og tu rnam par bsgom/ /de yi lam du khab ni me'i/ /gzugs can 'jug par rab bsams te/ /snying gar byin za'i sa bon nyid/ /dmigs nas skad cig gsod par byed/ /rgyud 'di la ni bsreg blugs med/ /phyag rgya bcing dang bya ba'ang med/ /rgyud chen bklags pas 'grub pa nyid/ /bsam gtan tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtog med dngos grub sbyin pa po/ /srid pa sbyong ba nyams dga' ba/ /gsang ba mchog ni bshad bya yis/ /nyon cig lha mo bzhin bzang ma/ /rin chen gzi brjid 'bar ba yi/ /phreng ba 'khrugs pa lha mo ltos/ /ma phug pas ni sbyor bral 'gyur/ /phug pas dga' ba sbyin pa po/ /de ltar 'khor ba 'dod pa yi/ /yon tan lnga ldan rin chen nyid/ /ma dag pas ni dug tu 'gro/ /dag pas bdud rtsi lta bur 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i rnam pas he ru ka /'gro ba sgrol ba'i gtso bo nyid/ /gang gi gzugs kyis gyur pa nyid/ /de ni nga yis smra yis nyon/ /snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/ /byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /sha yis pukka sī ru bya/

/de bzhin khrag gis ri khrod ma/ /gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod/ /g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /lpags pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ /rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid/ /bdag med mas gsol ba/ sngags btu ba ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /gang gi sngags kyi skye bo yi/ /las kyi dngos grub 'gyur ba nyid/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po rdo rje snying po gzi brjid chen pos bka' stsal pa/ sngags ni khyod la ngas bshad kyis/ /lha mo shes rab chen mo nyon/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad sbyin/ /uṣma rnams kyi bzhi ba la/ /pukka sīs brgyan stong pas mnan/ /mdog dkar mthar ni swā hā sbyar/ /'dis ni bzlas pa 'bum gyis ni/ /'gro ba rtag tu rengs par byed/ /dang por yi ge'i bdag po gzhag /de rjes mkha' spyod ma de nas/ /mthar ni swā hā sbyar byas na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang dbang du byed/ /rig byed rnams kyi dang po sbyin/ /dang po yi ni gnyis pa la/ /stong bcas mthar ni swā hā sbyar/ /sangs rgyas kyang sprod shes rab can/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad sbyin/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /ra dang ldan zhing chu mas brgyan/ /stong bcas swā hā yang dag ldan/ /mi rnams thams cad sdang bar byed/ /dang por yi ge'i dbang phyug gzhag /lnga pa nyid kyi gsum pa la/ /stong pa mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan/ /mthar ni swā hā mngon spyod che/ /yang ni yi ge'i thu bo sbyin/ /hūm̐ ni khrag dang 'dra ba yi/ /mthar ni swā hā thig le mchog /dga' bzang ma sogs rtag tu 'gugs/ /gti mug rigs ni dang por sbyin/ /ghuḥni yang dag rab tu sbyar/ /mthar ni swā hā yang byas na/ /lha dang mi rnams gsod par byed/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad gzhag /dang po nyid kyi dang po la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang sbyar/ /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan/ /yang ni dang po'i rtse mo la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan/

/mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa la/ /yang ni de nyid yang dag ldan/ /steng du chom rkun ma yis brgyan/ /de rjes hrīḥyis rnam pa sbyar/ /mthar yang swā hā spyod pa nyid/ /ku ru kulla'i sngags so/ /oṃ ni dang po bzhi pa yi/ /gsum pa chom rkun ma yis brgyan/ /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa la/ /pi tsu badzra sbyar ba dang / /uṣma rnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /pukka sī yis rnam par brgyan/ /stong pas mnan zhing sum 'gyur nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa la/ /gsum pa'i dang po mthar swā hā/ /kye yi rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /snang mdzad dang po dzwa la gnyis/ /sbyar nas lnga pa'i bzhi pa la/ /mthar gnas rnams kyi dang por ldan/ /ghasma rīs ni rnam par brgyan/ /uṣma rnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yis brgyan/ /stong pas mnan zhing sum 'gyur nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa'i dang po mthar swā hā/ /phyag bzhi pa'i sngags so/ /dang por rnam snang dang po yi/ /dang po nang gi dkar mos brgyan/ /gsum pa nyid kyi dang po la/ /nang gi dkar mos rnam par brgyan/ /nyis 'gyur lnga ba'i gsum pa dang / /gnyis pa'i gsum pa me yis brgyan/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa gsum sbyar nas/ /lnga pa nyid kyi gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa'i dang po mthar swā hā/ /phyag drug pa'i sngags so/ /dang por rnam snang bzhi pa yi/ /dang por byin za yang dag ldan/ /ro langs ma yis rnam par brgyan/ /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa la/ /ghasma rī yis rnam par brgyan/ /dang po yi ni dang po la/ /mthar gnas pa yi dang po dang / /rdo rje ma yis rnam par brgyan/ /kṣa ni chom rkun ma yis brgyan/ /lnga pa nyid kyi dang po dang / /uṣma rnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yis brgyan/ /stong pas mnan zhing sum 'gyur te/ /phaṭa dang mthar ni swā hā nyid/ /phyag gnyis pa'i sngags so/ /bdag med dang po'i dang po dang / /gnyis pa nyid kyi dang po dang / /gsum pa yi ni dang po dang /

/bzhi pa nyid kyi dang po dang / /lnga pa yi ni dang po dang / /mthar gnas kyi ni dang po dang / /uṣma rnams kyi dang po nyid/ /dang por rnam snang mthar swā hā/ /grong khyer dkrugs pa'i sngags kyi bzlas pa ni 'bum mo/ /mthar gnas rnams kyi gnyis pa dang / /kṣa yi rnam pa nyis 'gyur nyid/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa gsum dang ldan/ /dang por rnam snang phaṭa nyid kyi/ /rnam pa nang bcug mthar swā hā/ /sa sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /dang por rnam snang de rjes su/ /rdo rje ma yi mtha' ru hūm̐/ /bza' ba dang btung ba byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad nyid/ /de rjes a kā ro mu khaṃ/ /uṣma rnams kyi gsum pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa nyid/ /steng du me yis rnam par brgyan/ /dharmā ṇāṃ de rjes rdo rje ma/ /byin la dya nutpinna twāta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i sngags so/ /kyai rdo rje las sngags btu ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas chos kun sdom gcig pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes byas gsungs/ /bdag med tsumba na mdzad nas/ /bzlas pa'i yul ni rab tu dbye/ /shel gyis rengs pa'i bzlas pa nyid/ /dbang la tsandan dmar po nyid/ /lung thang gis ni mngon spyod nyid/ /ni raṃ sus ni sdang ba la/ /rta yi rus pas skrod pa nyid/ /bram ze'i rus pas dgug pa nyid/ /glang po'i rus pas char pa la/ /ma he yis kyang gsad pa la/ /rengs par 'o ma'i btung ba nyid/ /dbang la rang gi 'dun pas sbyang / /gsad ba la ni sihla nyid/ /dgug pa la ni bzhi mnyam nyid/ /sdang la sā lu skyes pas brjod/ /bskrad pa nyid la gla rtsir brjod/ /yang na mtha'i shwa dang dang po'i shwa dang na dang po dang / ga dang po dang / ha dang po nyid kyang de bzhin no/ /kyai rdo rje las bzlas pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu pa'o// //kyai rdo rje la dam 'khyud cing / /tshems kyis ma mchu rab btsir nas/ /lus can rnams kyi rigs kyi gzugs/

/de la bdag med mas zhus pa/ /bha gar liṅga bzhag nas ni/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pas 'di skad gsungs/ /lus can rang gi rigs bshad kyis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma nyon/ /bud med dam ni skyes pa yi/ /gang gi srin lag rtsa ba la/ /rdo rje rtse dgu bar gyur pa/ /mi bskyod pa yi rigs mchog nyid/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi 'khor lor 'gyur/ /dpag med mgon gyi 'dam skyes nyid/ /rin chen 'byung gi rin chen nyid/ /las kyi rigs kyi ral gri nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa gang nag po nyid/ /de yi lha ni mi bskyod pa/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar po che/ /de yi lha ni rnam snang mdzad/ /rnal 'byor pa gang sngo bsangs che/ /de yi lha ni don yod nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa gang ser po che/ /rin chen bdag po rigs kyi lha/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar dmar nyid/ /'od dpag med pa rigs kyi lha/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar dang ser/ /de ni sems dpa'i rigs su 'gyur/ /skye bo rnal 'byor mthar phyin pas/ /nga rgyal mi bcag tho mi btsam/ /kun rdzob gzugs su gnas nas ni/ /de rnams bde gshegs rigs su 'gyur/ /bud med rnams kyi mtshan nyid 'di/ /ji ltar skyes pa de bzhin no/ /kun rdzob tha snyad tshul las ni/ /de yi rigs su'ang de 'gyur ro/ /bha gar liṅgas tsum mdzad nas/ /de la rdo rje che mnyes nas/ /bdag med ma yis go mdzad pa/ /lha mo rab tu mchod pa nyon/ /tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang / /bdag gi khyim gyi nang du yang / /gcer bus phyag rgya cher byas nas/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /tsumba 'khyud pa byas nas ni/ /de bzhin bha gar reg pa nyid/ skyes pa'i sna ni gzhib pa nyid/ /ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi btung ba nyid/ /rtag tu myos pa'i mtshan ma las/ /bo la ldan pas lag pas bya/ /khyogs dang bla zhes bya ba dang / /de bzhin shin tu bkal ba nyid/ /yang yang rdo rjes 'dod pa bya/ /steng dang 'og tu blta ba nyid/ /dngos grub rgyas pa 'thob pa ste/

/sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /de la ga bur btung ba bya/ /de la ga bur rgyu yi phyir/ /sha ni bza' ba nyid du bya/ /khyad par du yang chang nyid do/ /kyai rdo rje las lhan cig skyes pa'i sbyor ba don gyi le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas rdo rje can gyis dbang / /bzhi yi don ni bka' stsal pa/ /rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid/ /che dang dril bu chen po bzung / /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ba/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /rdo rje dang padma byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ padma su khā dhā ra ma hā rā ga su khaṃ dang / tsa tu rā nanda bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ karyaṃ ku ru ṣwa me/ oṃ badzra ma hā dwe ṣa tsa tu rā nanda dā ya ka kha ga mu kha e ka ra so nā tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ karyaṃ ku ru ṣwa me/ spyi bor ni oṃ gyi rnam pa/ snying gar ni hūm̐ gi rnam pa/ ze'u 'bru la āḥ'i rnam pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu ma'i brtag pa zhes bya ba brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis las phyung ba/ brtag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid kye'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang / dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //swasti/ thabs shes gnyis med rgyud kun gyi/ /yang rtser gyur pa dges rdor rgyud/ /'bum lnga bsrubs pa'i snying po yi/

/dpal ldan brtag pa gnyis pa 'di/ /'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po yis/ /dgos pa 'ga' zhig blos rig nas/ /chos sbyin ma mo'i 'phrul du bsgrubs/ /dge 'bras gangs ri ltar dkar des/ /rgyud 'di'i bshad sgrub zla zer gyis/ /phyogs kyi tha gru kun khyab ste/ /'gro kun zung 'jug gsang lam nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin sar reg gyur cig /ces pa'ang spar du sgrub pa po rang nyid kyis spel ba dge/ //sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 52 sa skya pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi rgyud 'grel skor/ dpal kye rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 51
